t: V. V. Voloshin, Candidate For Position Of Police Watchman

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

5391.

REPORT
Date October 30, 1933.
Subject (in full) V.Y.Voloshin, candidate for position of Police Watchman.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]
With reference to the attached application by Vladimir
Vassilievitch Voloshin for a position as a Police Watchman, I
report hereunder certain information concerning this individual
as known to this office :-
Voloshin arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin during August
1928. Here he was employed with the Russian Regiment, S.V.C.,
from September 1928 till November 1932 when he left the service
of his own accord and with a good service certificate. Since
that time he has been without a fixed employment.
On August 4, 1933, Voloshin and two other Russian youths
were arrested by the French Police for having assaulted Mr. A.J.
Veiss, of the editorial staff of the "Shanghai Zaria." The
circumstances of this affair are as follows :-
About a week prior to the assault the "Shanghai Zaria"
published an article on the subject of the activities of the
"Brotherhood of Russian Truth," an active Russian anti-communist
organization. It is reported that the article contained
incorrect information derogatory to the above organization.
Voloshin and his associates decided, on their own initiative,
to punish Mr. Veiss, acting editor of the "Shanghai Zaria" for
malicious misrepresentation of facts relating to the activities
of the "Brotherhood of Russian Truth." The assault was
unanimously condemned by representatives of various Russian
organizations, but at the same time it was pointed out that the
"Shanghai Zaria" was to blame for publishing incorrect information
and that the three youths acted under great provocation and out
of patriotic motives. In view of such attitude towards the
affair on the part of certain Russian organizations, Mr. Veiss
withdrew his charge and the case against the three accused was

报告
日期：1933年10月30日。
主题（全称）：V.Y. Voloshin，警员职位候选人。
制作人：D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 [签名]
关于弗拉基米尔·瓦西里耶维奇·沃洛申（Vladimir Vassilievitch Voloshin）申请警员一职的附呈申请书，兹就本办公室所知的该人情况报告如下：
沃洛申于1928年8月从天津抵达上海。在此期间，他自1928年9月至1932年11月受雇于俄国商团（Russian Regiment, S.V.C.），随后自愿离职，并持有良好的服务证明书。自此以后，他一直无固定职业。
1933年8月4日，沃洛申与另外两名俄国青年因殴打《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）编辑部成员 A.J. Veiss 先生而被法国巡捕逮捕。此事经过如下：
在殴打事件发生前约一周，《上海霞报》刊登了一篇关于“俄罗斯真理兄弟会”（Brotherhood of Russian Truth）活动的文章，该组织是一个活跃的俄国反共组织。据报道，该文章包含有关上述组织的不实贬损信息。沃洛申及其同伙自行决定，惩罚《上海霞报》代理编辑 Veiss 先生，因其恶意歪曲有关“俄罗斯真理兄弟会”活动的事实。此次殴打事件遭到各俄国组织代表的一致谴责，但同时也指出，《上海霞报》因发布不实信息而有过错，且这三名青年是在极大挑衅下出于爱国动机行事。鉴于某些俄国组织对此事持此种态度，Veiss 先生撤回了指控，上海第二特区地方法院于1933年8月16日驳回了对三名被告的起诉。
x D 5292。
